_doc: The Jackal raider fighter (openspec/changes/enemy-fighters design 1 and 4; weapons-and-shields design 13). Parsed by sc-core combat::fighters. Hull, shield, flight top speed, acceleration and turn rate, the guns and the AI's distances are the design's; the hangar point, the exit speed, the assist's time constants, the jink, the fire cone and the AI's set-up and time-outs are placeholders. Positions are in the mothership's frame (+X port, +Y dorsal, +Z bow).
name: Jackal raider

launch._doc: The drill launches two after_engage_s into Engage; the second leaves spacing_s after the first.
